post_text:
The POC-to-production gap is the same three things, every time:

1. Data quality surprises — the demo data was cleaner than reality.
2. Missing eval infrastructure — nobody can say what "better" means.
3. Unclear ownership — the model has no team, so it has no roadmap.

Close those three and the gap closes with them.

sourced_claims.claim: POC-to-production gap has three recurring causes
